# vpsie_file_smb_users (Data Source)

Lists the account's SMB users of the Files service. A password is never part of the answer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vpsie_file_smb_users" "all" {}

output "smb_user_names" {
  value = [for u in data.vpsie_file_smb_users.all.users : u.username]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `users` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the user was created.
- `dc_identifier` (String) The datacenter of the user's VPC.
- `identifier` (String) The SMB user identifier.
- `password_changed_at` (String) When the password was last set.
- `share_count` (Number) How many shares grant the user, null when the platform does not say.
- `username` (String) The user name.
